failure_summary.description: Agents omitted or gated cache saves, or refined results from an unsuitable cached base instead of preserving the already-covered constraints.
Agents missed requested domains from earlier turns or failed to handle missing mandatory inputs independently for each domain.
Agents confused state with city or encoded exact hotel location and star criteria inconsistently.
Agents imported tools or added unnecessary imports and custom logic instead of using the predeclared tools directly.

patch.reasoning: Clarify how to proceed when one requested domain lacks mandatory information but another is ready, cover explicit stay-length date derivation, and make recurring field-encoding and tool-environment expectations more concrete. A cache note addresses empty-result branches without restating the existing general save requirement.

edits.target:
## Missing mandatory information
Before searching, check the full conversation for all mandatory inputs required by each requested tool. If any are missing, do not invent values, use defaults, or run a partial search. Make one `seek_information` call asking only for the missing mandatory information across the requested domains; optional preferences are not mandatory inputs.
edits.content:
## Missing mandatory information
Build the requested actions from the full conversation, then check mandatory inputs separately for each requested domain. If information is missing for one or more domains, make one `seek_information` call asking only for those missing mandatory inputs; do not search a domain whose own mandatory inputs are incomplete. Still perform and cache searches for other requested domains whose mandatory inputs are complete. If the user gives an exact hotel check-in date and an explicit stay length in nights, use `adjust_date` to derive check-out; do not ask for a date that can be derived this way. Vague timing such as “a weekend” does not supply exact dates or a stay length.

edits.target: ## Validate tool arguments and preserve user intent
edits.content:
- For attraction searches, a state name or abbreviation supplied without a city belongs in `state`, not `city`. Preserve complete user-stated neighborhood labels; do not strip a city qualifier from a compound neighborhood label. When `stars` represents a minimum/maximum pair, encode an exact N-star request as `[N, N]`.
- In generated Python, call the predeclared tools directly. Do not import tool functions or define or redefine tool functions or tool models.

edits.target: - Bind the exact return value of every search, filter, sort, and nearest-results call to a variable, then save it with `save_to_cache` under a unique, descriptive key. Save refined results under a new key. Do not substitute hand-built dictionaries or redefined models for tool result objects.
edits.content: - Save each returned result even when its `search_results` is empty; do not make cache saving conditional on finding matches. An empty result from a new call is not a reason to print “No planning needed”—that response is only appropriate when existing cached results already satisfy every requested action and constraint.
